entities.title: Unrestricted run
entities.summary: Lifts the run tool's read-only allowlist and argument checks.
entities.scope: every session of the engine whose state directory holds config.json; the environment variable applies to the process that runs the tool (the daemon, or the in-process server)
entities.validation: A config.json that is not valid JSON counts as false; only the value true lifts the policy.
entities.details: Read by RunPolicy.Unrestricted on every run call, so editing config.json takes effect without a restart. The state directory is described in src/.dev/configuration.json (state-dir).
